purpose: Test whether more reliable prefetch removes the small remaining pauses without excessive serialized heartbeat work.
user_report: Stutters are almost imperceptible; remaining stutters are very small.

policy.entry: Existing serialized controller-completion TICK only, never GD DELIVER or SCI IRQ.
policy.first_block: Existing fresh-PAUSED512B PIO fetch(next,256,true), existing CRC take and complete cache append.
before_second_block: First block completed and passed CRC/cache publication
Repeat current event, interrupt, quiesce, abandonment, seed, loan, demand/service, reader/port, busy/deferred/speculation, cache/full/extent, stream position and DMA admission checks
Read the existing timer again after repeated guards
Require positive clock-valid elapsed time no greater than1144ticks from producer start

PIO WORK MAX BAD: Largest whole producer visit with valid timing, including one or two blocks and inter-block checks
SECOND SKIP ONE MAX OVER: Otherwise-eligible second blocks refused by time/profile admission
Whole valid producer visits strictly exceeding2344ticks
metrics.invalid_interval: Bad endpoint clock profile, zero elapsed or unsigned delta at least0x80000000; each invalid attempted block increments BAD once. Invalid admission clock prevents block2 and suppresses whole-visit maximum.
metrics.threshold_boundaries: Elapsed1144admits block2;1145refuses. Whole2344does not count as overrun;2345does.
metrics.capture_reset: Existing gesture resets all metrics and failure counters, preserving valid cache.

hardware_test.settings: SCI / Background On / Normal / Auto / CD music Off / RAM patches Off
hardware_test.workload: Same Evolution2 in-engine opening and movement area; also check FMVs.
hardware_test.capture: Both triggers plus B for about1second; release and move until intentional approximately20second stop; record one complete report cycle from CRC VALIDATED PHYSICAL READ AHEAD until that same heading returns, including all request timing pages.
discriminators: How many second blocks are admitted and completed?
Do checked production and foreground/request timings improve?
What are largest whole and single operation durations, invalid samples and soft-window exceedances?
Do subjective remaining stutters improve without harming FMVs?

limits: The3ms window guides admission and is not a worst-case duration guarantee. A started block may be slower than its reserve.
Doubling the measured1.44512ms maximum projects2.89024ms, not a guarantee. Longer IMASK15 occupancy can worsen responsiveness even if demand stalls shrink.
At60Hz ideal production is60KiB/s; applying the previous eligible fraction projects57.8KiB/s, narrowly above the retained workload56.5KiB/s.
Full-cache, extent, timing and demand skips reduce that ceiling.
No synchronized frame witness establishes the cause of every remaining tiny stutter.
Counters are diagnostic and include sampling overhead; compare the same workload.
